border.$description: Recipe (design#143): how a line is drawn. Tailwind's bare border, border-t, divide-x and the rest read border.width, so a pack that draws 2px beams changes one token, not the components.

elevation.$description: Recipe: what lifts off the page. A flat pack sets each to a transparent zero shadow.

raised.$description: A control that sits on its track: the slider thumb

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, selects, tooltips, toasts, dialogs, sheets, the command palette

control.$description: Recipe: control shape as corner radii. A square pack sets them all to its sawn edge; a round pack keeps the pills.

dot.$description: Radio, switch track and thumb, slider track and thumb, menu radio dot, scroll thumb, sheet grabber, usage bar

motif.$description: Recipe: the pack's motif set, as CSS background-image values. Atoms paint them where a placeholder or an unfilled share shows (bg-(image:--hn-motif-hatch)); skins use brace and cross. none draws nothing.

hatch.$description: The unfilled share of a progress track, a loading placeholder

brace.$description: One diagonal across a square cell

cross.$description: Both diagonals: the X of a cell

shell.$description: Recipe (design#152): the shell's layout. The defaults are the floating panels of the shell-layout vote; a flush pack sets inset and gap to 0 and seam to its border width, so neighbouring panels share one line.

inset.$description: Space between the shell's edge and its panels

seam.$description: How far neighbouring panels overlap: their border width for one shared line when gap is 0

rail.$description: Width of the nav column from 768 px of shell width

context.$description: Width of the context pane from 1024 px of shell width

nav-inset.$description: Padding of the nav column, and the space under the brand

nav-row.$description: Height of a rail row (RailItem); never below size.target

nav-pad.$description: Inline padding of a rail row

nav-divider.$description: Line under the brand, each rail row and each phone tab, in line.subtle; 0 draws none

brand-row.$description: Height of the brand row at the head of the rail

scrollbar.$description: Recipe (design#163): how native scrollbars draw. The colours are scrollbar.thumb, thumb-hover and track; a pack that wants the OS bar width sets width to auto.

width.$description: scrollbar-width of every scrolling box: thin or auto

size.$description: Bar thickness where a browser lacks scrollbar-width and draws ::-webkit-scrollbar
